note: Physical cards the collection owner holds and inspected, each with a stable id so a claim can cite the specimen rather than describe it in prose (#32). `photograph` is null until the image is supplied; the record is the evidence either way, and the file is what lets a third party re-check it. Photographs live in verification/specimens/ and are covered by LICENSE.md decision 4 as a category, so they can be added over time without a fresh approval.

specimens.observed: Physical German HOLO specimen inspected from a photograph: "Hops Relaxo", KP 150, Fahigkeit "Extraportion", attack "Dynamische Presse" 140, Illustr. GOSSAN, "JTG DE 117/159", Play! Pokemon Prize Pack stamp, (c)2025. This is the holo (V2) printing. The card face does not distinguish PPS7 from PPS8; PPS8 is the owner attribution.

Physical German copy inspected from a photograph: "Relaxo", BASIS, LV.20, 130 KP, "Fahigkeit: Immunitat" (This Pokemon cannot be affected by Special Conditions), attack "Bodyslam" 50, Pokedex line "NR. 143 Tagtraumer-Pokemon GR: 2,1 m GW: 460,0 kg", weakness Fighting x2, retreat 4. All three photographed copies carry card number XY179 with the black star promo symbol, "Illus. Ken Sugimori" and (c)2016 Pokemon, matching the English XY179 print. This also shows the promo was localized across Europe, which the Bulbapedia release note ("in the English Snorlax-GX Box") does not convey.
